mau.math: 1,000 monthly users fit within the 7,500-user free allowance, so it is free.
This is the Pro plan as a monthly price. The published annual base price is $2,988.
The Growth plan is $799 base, plus $0.05 for each user above the 25,000 included. For 50,000 users, that works out to $2,049 a month.
The Growth plan is $799 base, plus $0.05 for each user above the 25,000 included. For 100,000 users, that works out to $4,549 a month.
